description: Expected bytes derived by hand from the rule text at rc.5 (RC5-A); the reference engine does not yet produce them, so this vector is listed in tests/conformance/pending.json until RC5-B. The settings object of the MCP extension identifier, which no rule pinned before rc.5 (SITE1-01). MCP revision 2026-07-28 defines `extensions` as "a map of extension identifiers to per-extension settings objects", and AGSC-11-17 requires every byte a declared surface emits to be pinned by a rule and proved by a required vector — so the object itself had to become normative rather than be left to the published extension note. Derivation from AGSC-11-18 as amended: the map carries the identifier `com.agenticsystemcore/knowledge` (valid under MCP's _meta key naming rules, SEP-2133); its settings object has EXACTLY ONE member, `linkset`, whose value is the absolute https URL of this node's /.well-known/knowledge-linkset (AGSC-06-07), derived from site.base and never configured; and no other member is emitted, so a second member is a declaration that disagrees with the rule and is AGSC-E210 from validate-wellknown (AGSC-11-16, AGSC-11-19). That revision has no initialization handshake (AGSC-11-18 as corrected at rc.5, V9A-04), so the same object travels in the server/discover result and in the capabilities carried per request, and the two MUST be identical.
